title: Dead cells Food
description: Changes some food from Minecraft to food from dead cells
body:
### **Dead cells player?**
Hey, are you a fan of dead cells and food from this game? This texture pack is for you!🍗

### **What does it does?**
This texture pack changes some types of food from minecraft to food from dead cells diets (you can see in the pictures section)🍒

### **How to use it?**
Just download and enable the texture pack in the settings😎
